verses.1: I also served You with all my heart. My soul was committed to You. I gave my spirit to You, so that You could judge the nations.
verses.2: He shall not cry out, nor lift his voice, nor make any noise in the wilderness.
verses.3: Kane Ratzutz shall not be put to death, and Pishtah Kaha shall not be destroyed. True judgment will be carried out.
verses.4: He shall not strike, nor destroy anything that is established in the land according to judgment and his laws. No animals will be harmed thereby.
verses.5: As the Lord God said: “He created the heavens and their stars. He made the earth and its creatures. He gave life to mankind, and a breath of life to those who walk upon it.”
verses.6: I, Jehovah, call you in righteousness. I strengthen you with my hand, and I grant you victory. I make you a covenant between nations for all generations to come.
verses.7: To open my eyes wide, so that I can free a prisoner from prison. The inhabitants of the dark place must be freed too.
verses.8: I am Jehovah; that is my name and my glory. I will not give it to others. My songs are for the foolish.
verses.9: The old ones have now come forth, and the new ones will be revealed. I say this before they are fully grown.
verses.10: Sing to Jehovah with a new song. Its melody will rise from the ends of the earth. The waters will be filled, and their inhabitants will also be blessed.
verses.11: They will be taken from the desert and its cities. The walls will be destroyed; the kings will be overthrown. Those who live in the rocks on top of the mountains will also be overthrown.
verses.12: They will give glory to the LORD, and His praise will be sung in all lands.
verses.13: Yehova, as a warrior, will come forth from the battles. He will fill the land with fear and terror. No one can withstand his power. He will grow stronger over time.
verses.14: I have searched for a world beyond this one. I try to find a place where I can live in peace and harmony with others.
verses.15: I will destroy mountains and valleys, and all their vegetation. I will also create rivers and lakes.
verses.16: And I walked along paths that they did not know. They did not have any signs or directions to guide them. I will shine my light before them, and I will expose their lies. These people have done these things, and they still refuse to give up.
verses.17: Let us then be united, and let those who trust in God be saved. You are our gods.
verses.18: The deaf heard, and the blind saw.
verses.19: Who is more foolish than my servant and my beloved? I will send someone who is worthy of being called a servant of the LORD.
verses.20: Many eyes, but they won’t keep their ears open; they won’t listen at all.
verses.21: YHWH desires that, out of His righteousness, He may increase the honor and glory of His name.
verses.22: And it was a people who were always in chaos and turmoil. Their homes were filled with destruction. There was no one who could save them from their suffering. And there was no one who could say anything to stop it.
verses.23: Who among you will listen to this, and pay attention and hear it?
verses.24: Who gave Jacob and Israel to be slaves? It was the Lord who sinned against them. They did not follow His ways, nor did they listen to His commands.
verses.25: And heat from battle rushed upon him; flames of war surrounded him. He was terrified, and he couldn’t think clearly.
